# Discrete random variables

The expected value of a random variable is

$$
E[X] = \sum_x x\,P(X=x).
$$

For a Bernoulli random variable with parameter $p$,

$$
P(X=1)=p, \qquad P(X=0)=1-p,
$$
so

$$
E[X]=p,
\qquad
\mathrm{Var}(X)=p(1-p).
$$
